svg.title: Ansible Ops Platform on GCP: architecture
svg.desc: Terraform provisions, GitHub Actions delivers keylessly, AWX operates a private VM fleet on GCP, with event-driven self-healing and onboarding, alerts and an optional HTTPS entry.
svg.text: Daily operations automation with AWX (Ansible) · Terraform provisions · GitHub Actions delivers keylessly · events heal and onboard on their own
Google Cloud project gcp-awx-ops · region asia-south1
Private VPC · no public IPs · IAP and internal firewall only
dev group is patched first; prod waits for approval. Hardened with the cis role.
Push or PR → GitHub Actions run lint, Molecule and
Actions sign in with Workload Identity Federation (no
keys) and terraform apply the five stacks.
awx-config applies AWX settings as code and ops-trigger
launches jobs, through a private tunnel.
AWX builds its inventory from VM labels (keyless) and
runs patching, hardening and health checks over private
A stopped or new VM appears in the audit log → sink →
Pub/Sub → bridge → AWX heals or onboards it.
Failed jobs, approval requests and chosen successes post
to a chat webhook, with a link to the job.
ee-build pushes the custom execution environment to
Artifact Registry and AWX pulls it for template 05.
Google Cloud icons: official Google Cloud product and category icons (unmodified). Where a service has no icon of its own in the free set, its product category icon is used.
GitHub, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Ansible, Discord and Microsoft Teams marks belong to their owners and appear here only to identify the tools.
